title: ID0481509-DC/Si-D/FR-[ RVP/T3170004601] DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4
description:
Reported behavior/issue -  The error code "door open" appears in our logs even after rebooting the charging station.
Could you please take the necessary steps to ensure that all our chargers appear on the MSE portal?
The error code "door open" appears in our logs even after rebooting the charging station.
We did not send anyone to the site today.
Could you please verify on your end if it is indeed an open door?
The charger does not appear on the MSE portal.
Could you please take the necessary steps to ensure that all our chargers appear on the MSE portal?
Also, is it possible to use the account
"exploitation.irve@picoty.fr" as requested?

I checked the logs and I see the door switch error flag as well. From my point of view, if nobody opened the door, then it must be a loose connection.
After a reboot the error is no longer present.
I will check on how to proceed with the MSE portal charger addition and come back to you.
Let me know if you have any questions or doubts.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
